meta.cadence: GitHub Actions snapshot (not a guaranteed 15-minute tick; cron can drift or pause). STALE banner if snapshot age > 2 hours. On-page LIVE pulse: browser JSON-RPC to public Solana RPC (publicnode, mainnet-beta fallback) for slot/epoch/TPS at most every 60s. Snapshot values shown as NOT LIVE if RPC fails. Never invented.

live_pulse.label: LIVE / on-page-now vs snapshot generated_at
live_pulse.fail: NOT LIVE — last snapshot values; never invented
live_pulse.note: Browser JSON-RPC. publicnode first because api.mainnet-beta.solana.com 403s GitHub Pages Origin; publicnode CORS *. Same two keyless endpoints as generate.py. At most every 60s. Not a GitHub Actions tick.

dex.change_7d_meaning: percent change of 24h DEX volume vs the 24h from 7 days ago (not 7d-total vs prior 7d)

rwa.source: defillama.protocols chainTvls.Solana where category in {RWA, RWA Lending}

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

sampled.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.
sampled.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
sampled.sampled_runrate_note: sum(meta.fee) 0.0487 SOL over 9985s × 86400. ESTIMATED 24h in-protocol fees from the stratified sample, not a ledger.
sampled.note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2240 all-tx, n_nonvote=1082, window_seconds=9985. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2240 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9985s.

economics.median_tx_fee_note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 2 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 12 slots spread over a ~2.8h window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=2240 all-tx, n_nonvote=1082, window_seconds=9985. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=2240 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is 9985s.
economics.priority_note: priority est. = meta.fee − 5000×n_signatures (base fee 5000 lamports/sig). Sampled, NOT a 24h census.

jito.tips_24h_note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000389 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2165) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito.sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 75936 USD; at p95 floor → 1971030 USD.
jito.sensitivity_note: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 75936 USD; at p95 floor → 1971030 USD.

jito_runrate_not_rev.note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000389 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2165) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito_runrate_not_rev.label: INVALID as a 24h aggregate — tip_floor is per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx

economics.rev_definition: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV.
economics.rev_kind: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-08-29: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-08-29
economics.rev_sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 75936 USD; at p95 floor → 1971030 USD.

rev_components.label: Jito tip-floor run-rate (NOT REV)
rev_components.source: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000389 SOL) × non-vote TPS (2165) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.

rev_routes_tried.route: getBlock stratified sample run-rate (sum meta.fee / window_seconds × 86400)
rev_routes_tried.role: ESTIMATED in-protocol cross-check, not added (would double-count solana.com Fees)
INVALID as a 24h aggregate — sensitivity only, not headline REV
INVALID sensitivity only, not summed into REV
EXCLUDED — application/protocol fees, not network REV
MEASURED Jito gross MEV tips UTC day (jito_tips+validator_tips)

items.title:
7/
Solana's first stake-weighted vote drew participation from hundreds of millions of SOL on each proposal, well above the one-third quorum.

Proposals: https://governance.solana.com

SIMD-0550: https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0550-double-disinflation.md

SIMD-0607: https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/pull/607
items.summary: 7/ Solana's first stake-weighted vote drew participation from hundreds of millions of SOL on each proposal, well above the one-third quorum. Proposals: governance.solana.com SIMD-0550: github.com/solana-foundation… SIMD-0607: github.com/solana-foundation…
items.creator: @anza_xyz

items.title:
6/
SGP-0003  ❌ did not pass and would have split the base fee into an inclusion fee for leaders plus a resource fee scaling with usage.

Restructuring fees changes revenue for validators and cost modeling for every app. Most non-passing stake abstained rather than opposed.

Majority support on a first attempt is a strong starting point and we can expect a reparameterized version to return for a vote.
items.summary: 6/ SGP-0003 ❌ did not pass and would have split the base fee into an inclusion fee for leaders plus a resource fee scaling with usage. Restructuring fees changes revenue for validators and cost modeling for every app. Most non-passing stake abstained rather than opposed. Majority
items.creator: @anza_xyz

items.title:
5/
When SIMD-0550 activates, every validator computes staking rewards on the new schedule.

Rewards math must be bit-for-bit identical across Agave and Firedancer. Floating point can't guarantee that, so SIMD-0607 replaces it with deterministic integer math, targeting Agave v4.4.
items.summary: 5/ When SIMD-0550 activates, every validator computes staking rewards on the new schedule. Rewards math must be bit-for-bit identical across Agave and Firedancer. Floating point can't guarantee that, so SIMD-0607 replaces it with deterministic integer math, targeting Agave v4.4.
items.creator: @anza_xyz

items.title:
4/
So when does it activate?

The implementation of SIMD-0550 is a single permanent feature gate that sets the taper to 0.30.

One prerequisite is in review, then the gate can be scheduled.
items.summary: 4/ So when does it activate? The implementation of SIMD-0550 is a single permanent feature gate that sets the taper to 0.30. One prerequisite is in review, then the gate can be scheduled.
items.creator: @anza_xyz

items.title:
3/
SGP-0002 ✅ doubles the annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30%.

Terminal rate stays 1.5% and arrives earlier in the year 2029 instead of 2032. Roughly 18.9M fewer SOL issued over six years.
items.summary: 3/ SGP-0002 ✅ doubles the annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30%. Terminal rate stays 1.5% and arrives earlier in the year 2029 instead of 2032. Roughly 18.9M fewer SOL issued over six years.
items.creator: @anza_xyz

items.title:
2/
SGP-0001 ✅ ratifies the Solana Constitution.

Stake-weighted voting is now the formal process for network decisions. Validators vote with active stake. Delegators can override their validator directly.

timeline_public.item: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.”
solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic” remains a listing-token write-up for SIMD-525 (SIMD-0525).
SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Observed mean slot ~317 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC.
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether the 300 ms gate (effective epoch 1024 when activated at epoch-1023 start) is live once that epoch starts.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (250/200) get Feature accounts on mainnet.
Do not treat observed slot ms as activation proof.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.
